english.title: Conspire to contravene an obligation imposed by a control order - Terrorism Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to contravene, without reasonable excuse, an obligation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OBLIGATION..), imposed by

(E)_[a derogating control order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..)]_
(F)_[a non-derogating control order made by the Secretary of State on **(..SPECIFY DATE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired together with others
to contravene without reasonable excuse an obligation imposed by
a derogating control order made by a court OR
a non-derogating control order made by the Secretary of State

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document was REPEALED by section 1of the Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measures Act 2011 as from 14/12/2011.

This offence wording should be used where the control order was still in existence.

other.penalty:
Indictment only: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None
